qualifier: with interstrand crosslink and replication-fork repair, PARylation
name: Double-strand break, crosslink and replication-fork DNA repair
rationale: Members cover HR/NHEJ/SSA/MMEJ double-strand break repair, BRCA1/2-PALB2 defects, Fanconi/ICL repair, fork reversal and PARylation, lacking the base-excision, mismatch, nucleotide-excision, translesion and telomere repair that the near-superset confusable adds.

name: Chemokine signaling in dendritic cell migration and maturation
rationale: Members combine chemokine-receptor modules with dendritic cell (and NK) chemotaxis, survival and maturation, whereas confusables have either chemokine clusters without dendritic cell members or DC chemotaxis without chemokine-receptor binding.

name: IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction
rationale: All three members concern IRF3-driven activation of type I interferon, distinct from the RIG-I/MDA5, TLR7/9 and negative-regulation interferon confusables.

name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors
rationale: Members describe vitamin K response and the gamma-carboxylation, ER-to-Golgi transport and propeptide removal of Gla-protein precursors, unlike the coagulation-cascade and vitamin C/E confusables.

name: Arterial endothelial differentiation and dorsal aorta morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern endothelial (arterial) cell differentiation and dorsal aorta formation, whereas confusables cover endocardial, coronary, valve and outflow-tract development.

name: Striated muscle adaptation: atrophy, growth and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members share muscle adaptation to activity or inactivity (atrophy, skeletal and cardiac growth, sarcomere organization, fast/slow fiber transition), distinct from confusables centred on cell size, calcineurin-driven hypertrophy or myogenesis.

name: Hedgehog signal transduction via SMO and GLI processing
rationale: Members cover SMO activation, ciliary localization and proteasomal GLI1/2/3 processing in the receiving cell, unlike confusables on Hh ligand lipidation/release, neural tube patterning and planar cell polarity.

qualifier: with suppression of amyloid precursor protein metabolism
name: Sphingolipid biosynthesis and amyloid precursor protein suppression
rationale: Members combine de novo sphingolipid/sphingomyelin biosynthesis and homeostasis with negative regulation of APP synthesis and catabolism, whereas confusables carry sphingolipid catabolism, lipid transfer or amyloid fibril formation.

qualifier: with NADPH regeneration and protein repair
name: Reactive oxygen and aldehyde detoxification with NADPH regeneration
rationale: Members span ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, methylglyoxal/aldehyde catabolism, isocitrate-linked NADPH regeneration and oxidized protein repair, distinct from glutathione-synthesis, ferroptosis and vitamin C confusables.

qualifier: death receptor apoptosis, necroptosis, non-NLRP3 inflammasomes
name: Death receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and IL-18-linked pyroptosis
rationale: Members join caspase-8/FADD death-receptor signaling and necroptosis with AIM2/NLRP1/IPAF/caspase-4/5 inflammasomes, pyroptosis and IL-18, while confusables have either mitochondrial apoptosis without inflammasomes or NLRP3/IL-1 without death-receptor signaling.

name: Pancreatic progenitor and neuroendocrine lineage differentiation
rationale: Members cover multipotent and NEUROG3+ pancreatic progenitors, alpha-cell and exocrine development, plus neuroendocrine/adrenal differentiation, unlike confusables on definitive endoderm and gastrulation.

qualifier: NK cytotoxicity and T cell costimulation
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity, costimulation and tolerance regulation
rationale: Members regulate NK cytotoxicity and receptors, T cell costimulation, proliferation, anergy and Treg differentiation, and DC activation, which the confusables (thymic tolerance, DC signatures, cytokine suppression, Treg/TCR signaling) cover only partly.

qualifier: very long-chain and polyunsaturated, ether lipid synthesis
name: Very long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acid elongation, ether lipids
rationale: Members cover long/very long-chain acyl-CoA synthesis, saturated and LA/ALA elongation, and plasmalogen/wax ether lipid biosynthesis, distinct from peroxisomal oxidation, peroxisome import and cholesterol synthesis confusables.

qualifier: reverse cholesterol transport and foam cell suppression
name: Regulation of cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, storage, foam cell formation, HDL clearance and LXR-driven efflux genes, whereas confusables emphasise HDL assembly and remodeling or cholesterol import.

name: Phospholipid scrambling, phosphatidylserine exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members link phospholipid translocation/scrambling and PS exposure to recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, while confusables have flippase/membrane traffic without clearance or clearance-adjacent foam cell terms without scrambling.

name: Cysteinyl leukotriene synthesis and eicosanoid receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover LTC4/LTD4 synthesis and transport, leukotriene and prostanoid receptors and GPCR modules, distinct from lipoxin/LTB4 catabolism, prostaglandin synthesis and histamine confusables.

name: Proximal TCR signaling and T cell activation
rationale: Members share TCR-triggered T cell activation, including CD3/zeta phosphorylation and ZAP-70 recruitment, distinct from confusables on CD28 costimulation, downstream TCR signaling and thymocyte/B cell development.

name: Actin-driven ruffling, podosome formation and macropinocytosis
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization into ruffles, lamellipodia, pseudopodia and podosomes and macropinocytosis, unlike confusables focused on actin severing/bundling, Arp2/3 nucleation or Rho GTPase cycles.

core: Circadian and nuclear receptor control of metabolism
name: Circadian and nuclear receptor control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members join BMAL1/CLOCK and ROR/REV-ERB transcription with PGC-1alpha, PPARA, heme signaling, beta-cell growth and thermogenesis, distinct from core clock mechanics, adipogenesis and gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: Cardiac contractility and SERCA calcium uptake regulation
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation together with SR calcium import and ATPase activity, unlike confusables centred on calcium release, membrane potential or hypertrophy.

name: Toll-like receptor IKK/TAK1 and noncanonical NIK NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members cover TLR/TRIF-IRAK-TRAF6 activation of TAK1, IKK and TBK1 plus NIK-dependent noncanonical NF-kappaB and IKK deficiencies, while confusables are TNFR1-centred or lymphocyte-receptor NF-kappaB.

name: Chromatin remodeling and ADP-ribosylation at DNA damage sites
rationale: Members concern nucleosome organization and assembly, CHD remodelers, protein-chromatin loading and PARylation at damaged or replicating DNA, lacking the double-strand break repair pathways and telomere terms of its confusables.

name: Platelet GPCR agonist signaling via G12/13 and Rho
rationale: Members cover thrombin-PAR, ADP-P2Y, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling with G12/13-Rho activation, whereas confusables emphasise VWF/GPVI adhesion, degranulation and coagulation.

qualifier: cellular responses to LH, FSH and GnRH
name: Cellular responses to gonadotropins and GnRH
rationale: Members concern glycoprotein hormone receptors and cellular responses to LH, FSH and GnRH, unlike confusables on gonadotropin secretion, activin and gonad development.

name: Cellular iron uptake and heme oxygenase response to metals
rationale: Members combine iron import and homeostasis with BACH1/HMOX1 regulation and responses to cobalt, lead and selenium, distinct from zinc/copper/cadmium transport and oxygen-sensing confusables.
